messages:
maya: FYI customer 'acme' is seeing immediate 400s on tool calls after the overnight registry backfill. Happens for both SDK and raw API. Example response: `400 schema_validation_error: unexpected field \"toolNameLongForm\"`

maya: curl repro we used:
```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall \n -H 'Authorization: Bearer ********' \n -d '{"tool":"company/integration/very-long-tool-name-v2-release-candidate","args":{"q":"test"}}'```

support-bot: Ticket created: #SUP-3219 (auto)

priya: Can you paste the exact request body + the full response body from the API gateway logs? Also which region and customer tenant?

maya: Sent logs DM with request/response. Tenant: acme-us, region: us-west-2. Response body includes: `{"error":"schema_validation_error","details":"unexpected field \"toolNameLongForm\"; expected \"tool\" matching registry entry"}`

alex: Quick debug: I pulled the registry entry for the tool. Backfill job truncated handles >64 chars. Registry now has `company/integration/very-long-tool-name-v2-release-cand` (64 chars) instead of the original long form. Client still sending full long form. Server validates incoming JSON against registry handle and fails schema check.

maya: Ah, so this is a mismatch between client-side handle and post-backfill registry canonicalization. Did the backfill change normalization rules or just truncate?

alex: It appears the backfill applied a truncation step to legacy names to keep index sizes down. The API surface (validation) uses the registry canonical handle. We should have created aliases but the alias-machine job errored for this tenant (seen an OOM in the logs).

priya: Do we have a quick mitigation we can give the customer?

alex: Short term: two options:
1) Recommend using the tool UUID instead of the handle in the request (UUID is unaffected). Example: `{"tool_uuid":"f7d6c3a2-...."}`
2) Set temporary header `X-Enable-legacy-handle: true` which bypasses registry strict match for legacy handles (internal toggle, will be enabled for acme).

maya: I've applied header toggle for acme-tenant and confirmed their calls moved from 400 -> 200 in the next minute.

eng-liz: Root cause action: RI-4876 created to update backfill to emit aliases and to add streaming retry for alias-machine. Plan: patch + canary in 2h, full rollout after verification. https://redwood.internal/ri/4876

alex: Also adding a validation test to the SDK to warn if handles >64 chars are used (helps customers proactively).

priya: Can we add an automated check in the backfill so it fails fast if alias-machine OOMs instead of leaving registry with partial state?

eng-liz: Yes — that's in the RI-4876 checklist. Also adding a monitoring alert: "alias-sync-mismatch" when a handle exists with length mismatch and no alias entry.

maya: Customer notified and on the workaround for now. Will follow up once RI-4876 lands. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

support-bot: Scheduled patch deploy window: in 2h (canary) -> full rollout in 6h. Notifying SRE oncall.
